scenario.name: static-corpus-row-validator
scenario.description: Offline source/harness contract check for R-CW-6; cannot establish the process-local runtime boundary receipt.

expectedReceipts.name: static-source-harness-evidence
expectedReceipts.description: Static source and harness checks for the chain-cap guard.

expectedReceipts.name: non-runtime-boundary
expectedReceipts.description: The output explicitly says it is not R-CW-6 process-local runtime evidence.

review.notes: Static boundary check only; it cannot produce or fold a runtime R-CW-6 PASS. It is the required preflight of R-CW-6: an F″ corpus records it under preflight_attachments, not as a proof row, and R-CW-6 is PASS only when this check passed at the same candidate.

preflightAttachment.notes: Retired as a proof row: F′ and older corpora keep R-CW-6A as the row they folded. Run at the exact candidate, the static validator reads PROOFS/<candidate>/R-CW-6/cael-dgx/, never INDEX static_evidence_sha, and writes required-preflight-receipt.json for grade-preflight-gated-row.mjs and validate-corpus.mjs.

liveRunSafety.notes: Offline validation is intentionally excluded from live-suite and from process-local R-CW-6 certification.
